top_signals.title: China Goes on Oil Buying Spree as Crude Prices Slide
top_signals.summary: Chinese refiners have started buying more crude oil from abroad, taking advantage of lower prices in recent weeks to replenish the country’s oil inventories, Bloomberg has reported, citing traders. According to the report, Sinopec has bought about 20 million barrels of crude since the start of this month from West Africa alone, for loading in December. This compares with 20-25 million barrels of West African crude for all Chinese buyers monthly, on average. Yet Chinese refiners are also stepping up their purchases of Middle Eastern and Brazilian…
